name: Mails.ai API
description:
The Mails.ai API gives AI agents a real email identity: send and receive
transactional email, with every inbound message run through an intent + prompt-injection classifier
and delivered to you as a typed event.

## Authentication
All endpoints take a Bearer API key:

```
Authorization: Bearer mk_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Keys carry one or more scopes — `send`, `read`, `manage` — and a mode: **live** (`mk_live_…`) or
**test** (`mk_test_…`).

## Test mode
A `mk_test_` key exercises the entire API — real validation, persisted resources, real
`message.sent`/`*.received` events and webhooks — without sending real email or incurring cost. Build and
test your whole integration on a test key, then flip one character to `mk_live_` to go live.
`POST /v1/test/inbound` (test key only) lets you simulate inbound mail end-to-end.

## Idempotency
Send endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header; a repeated key replays the stored response instead of
sending twice.

## Pagination
List endpoints are cursor-paginated: pass `limit` (1–100) and the `next_cursor` from the previous page.

## Errors
Errors use a stable envelope: `{ "error": { "type", "code", "message", "param", "request_id" } }`. Every
response carries an `X-Request-Id` header for support correlation.
